title: Plantation agriculture states in India
subject: Geography
caption: Map showing Indian states with plantation agriculture (Assam, Nagaland, Kerala) versus Rajasthan where it is absent.
altText: A clear, high‑resolution map of India on a white background. Assam, Nagaland, and Kerala are colored bright green to indicate the presence of plantation agriculture, and their names are labeled in bold black text. Rajasthan is colored light gray to show the absence of plantation agriculture, also clearly labeled. All other states are shown in a neutral light gray. A legend in the lower left corner explains the green shading as "Plantation agriculture present" and the gray shading as "Plantation agriculture absent". A scale bar and north arrow are included for reference. The illustration is accurate, with clean state borders and a textbook‑style layout.
